entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size and I'm not paying for your company's mistake!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having an issue with the fit. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. You better handle this right now. This jersey is way too tight, and if I don't get a full refund, I'm going to post a review on every single website I can find. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on December 27th. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference regarding the fit?
Are you deaf? I said it's the wrong size! It's too tight! I'm not interested in some stupid exchange for another one, I just want my money back. I want to speak to your manager, right now.
I can definitely handle this for you, there's no need to escalate the call. I just needed to confirm the reason. One moment while I review the return eligibility for your jersey.
Don't 'one moment' me. Your website says 10 days. I know my rights. This is basic customer service.

You are absolutely correct, sir. I've confirmed that your item falls under our 10-day return policy, and you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I'm approving your return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? Fine. How do I send it back?

I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. You can simply print that out, package the jersey, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Hmph. About time. Make sure it's done quickly.
We'll process it as soon as it arrives. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
